newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: The Bombay Metals Exchange was closed on Monday for a Hindu festival.
On Friday, metals' prices held steady in a narrow range on poor industrial demand, dealers said.
Ready copper was unchanged at 11,700 rupees per quintal and nickel at 37,500 rupees per quintal. On Thursday copper was down by 50 rupees and nickel by 300 rupees per quintal.
Aluminium, zinc and lead prices were also unchanged.
